missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend CoQ10 for generic energy or anti-aging claims; clarify symptoms, medicines and any specific diagnosis.
safety_exclusions: Do not claim CoQ10 reverses aging or reliably treats nonspecific fatigue.
Do not infer mitochondrial disease or deficiency from low energy.
Do not duplicate existing CoQ10 products.
professional_escalation_conditions: Persistent unexplained fatigue, cardiovascular disease, cancer treatment or warfarin use.
population_and_context: People selecting generic energy or vitality as a goal without a defined indication for coenzyme Q10.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. Any indication-specific use requires separate evidence review and interaction assessment.
certainty_and_limitations: NCCIH CoQ10 resources describe uncertainty across indications and potential medicine interactions; generic wellness claims are not established.
